description: SQL-SUB-03 and SQL-SUB-04, deciding variants: correlation name precedence and the demand of EXISTS shapes. Over Ev asks a correlated count through an alias, through a shadowing same-named table, three levels of nesting, and EXISTS with DISTINCT, TOP 1, GROUP BY and with a failing projection 1/x.Denominator (row Id 2 fails), each as its own statement. Follow-up probe (status F) for SQL-SUB-03, SQL-SUB-04; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: SELECT Id, (SELECT Count(*) FROM Ev AS e2 WHERE e2.Id <= Ev.Id) AS c FROM Ev
SELECT Id, (SELECT Count(*) FROM Ev WHERE Id <= Ev.Id) AS c FROM Ev
SELECT Id FROM Ev AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Ev AS b WHERE b.Id = a.Id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Ev AS c WHERE c.Id = a.Id))
SELECT Id FROM Ev WHERE EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT x.Id FROM Ev AS x WHERE x.Id = Ev.Id)
SELECT Id FROM Ev WHERE EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 x.Id FROM Ev AS x WHERE x.Id = Ev.Id)
SELECT Id FROM Ev WHERE EXISTS (SELECT x.Id FROM Ev AS x WHERE x.Id = Ev.Id GROUP BY x.Id)
SELECT Id FROM Ev WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 / x.Denominator FROM Ev AS x WHERE x.Id = Ev.Id)
